title: acinos alpinus subsp. majoranifolius
intro: Acinos alpinus subsp. majoranifolius, commonly known as Alpine savory, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Acinos alpinus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is said to have a positive effect on the digestive system. The therapeutic actions of Alpine savory include acting as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of infections, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Alpine savory include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
